Grapple.description: Wrestling or physically restraining a target.

Psionic.description: Silent mental manipulation or psychic assault.

Vocal.description: Roars, howls, speech, or sonic bursts. Highly audible.

Secretion.description: Emitting biological fluids like sweat, poison, or ink clouds.

Pheromone.description: Chemical signaling used for hive-mind communication.

Construct.description: Building physical map structures like webs or nests.

Healing.description: Restores HP, mends wounds, or cures status effects.

Enhancement.description: Applies positive modifier payloads to self or allies.

Curse.description: Applies negative modifier payloads to enemies.

Stance.description: Shifting physical posture or combat style.

Passive.description: Innate trait. Cannot be cast. Permanently active on entity generation.

Action.description: A general-purpose active ability not fitting a specific combat category.

Area_Of_Effect.description: An action whose geometry affects multiple entities in a defined spatial area.

Damage.description: An action whose primary output is HP reduction on the target.

Defense.description: A reactive or proactive ability that reduces or negates incoming damage or effects.

Reaction.description: Triggered automatically out-of-turn in response to a specified enemy action.
